decisions.reason: As the publicly presented flagship platform and central investment, dropping it would write off substantial sunk costs and expose the firm's announced direction as a mistake, so escalation pressures make a drop very unlikely.

The firm has invested in its development and given it a dedicated product page, creating sunk costs and public commitment that, while less central than the flagship, favor persistence rather than dropping.
Visible version updates and its own product page indicate ongoing investment and public commitment, so escalation of commitment suggests keeping it even though it is not a central flagship.
